blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) clarified on Friday that five former household staff members of Vice President Sara Duterte were not rescued or held captive but were merely accompanied by police personnel at the request of their legal counsel. The PNP issued the clarification after verifying claims made by Duterte’s lawyer, Atty.
